detail_text: Specifically, A.Your firm has multiple standard operating procedures (global corporate and site specific) instructing employees how to handle consumer complaints and quality notifications (nonconformance and out of specification investigations) for a uniform and timely closure. The instructions provided in these standard operating procedures are unclear about the timeframe these consumer complaints and quality notifications are acceptable to remain unclosed. There are approximately 276 significant consumer complaints [redacted] remaining unclosed for longer than 100 days. Your firm failed to process and close these [redacted] consumer complaints in a uniform and timely manner. There were approximately 6 nonconformance records which remained unclosed for longer than 60 days. B.Your firm failed to establish an action or alert limit for consumer complaint trending review and analysis in a standard operating procedure. The following consumer complaints were not reviewed for trending analysis: 1.Approximately 12 consumer complaints for AHG Anti-IgG + Anti-C3d lot 8749190-03, including false negative testing results. 2.Approximately 2 consumer complaints for AHG Anti-IgG 48 IH card lot [redacted], including questionable or equivocal results and weak false positive results. 3.Approximately 3 consumer complaints for AHG Anti-IgG 48 IH card lot 8923050, including false negative test results and dried cards. 4.Approximately 2 consumer complaints for IH-Card AHG Anti-IgG lot [redacted], including false positive test results.

detail_text: Specifically, There is a failure to thoroughly review any unexplained discrepancy from the firm's contract testing lab used for stability studies of ERVEBO drug product vaccine and related materials. For example, the contract testing lab in is used to perform stability studies for ERVEBO vaccine (recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus-Zaire Ebola live attenuated virus). From 2019-2023, there were 7 out of 18 stability deviations from this contract testing lab for different reasons including missed stability time point; use of expired media for cell potency assay; sample mismanagement; incorrect temperature sample storage during testing; and other reasons. The firm has not fully investigated these deviations to ensure that the contract testing lab is managing the stability samples and performing the stability testing correctly. Roger F Zabinski
